files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
## Changed
- stop Firefox collapsing the page when toggling checkboxes
- fixed an issue where the editor was not using the user's preferred language

lines: CHANGELOG.md has the heading for 10.1.2, but nothing under it.
The App Store would show only the sections of its pre-releases. Where nothing changed since the last of them, the section says so: No notable changes since <pre-release>.
